Interval Repeater Timer

Looping work/rest interval timer with round tracking, phase beeps and a progress bar — for HIIT, Tabata and focus sprints.

Ready

📖 How to use

  1. Enter work seconds, rest seconds and number of rounds.
  2. Press Start — phases alternate automatically.
  3. Watch the phase, round indicator and progress bar.
  4. Press Stop anytime to end the session.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I use it for Tabata?

Yes — set any work and rest lengths in seconds and any number of rounds. A common Tabata setup is 20s work / 10s rest × 8 rounds.

What do the beeps mean?

Three short beeps count down the last 3 seconds of each phase; a longer beep marks every phase change.

Is there a rest after the last round?

The timer stops after the final work phase — there is no rest after the last round.
